## Summary

One short paragraph explaining what changed and why it materially improves the
project (not a generic refactor).

## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation / archive treatment
- [ ] Tooling / CI
- [ ] Visual / aesthetic
- [ ] Other

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (if runtime code changed)
- [ ] Screenshots regenerated, if the interface changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Reading docs updated only where necessary

## Notes for reviewers

Anything non-obvious about the implementation, measured trade-off, or
preserved experimental behavior.
